note: The 27-factor matching vector, plus Confidence. This file is the controlled vocabulary ONLY — no scores live here and none live on profession records. Two jobs: it constrains role_spread.deviating_roles so variance between job roles inside one profession is expressed in the pipeline's language, and it names the factors baseline_rating.json rates every profession on. MIGRATED FROM 19 FACTORS on 2026-09-20: nine slugs renamed to match the scoring engine (verbal->verbal_intelligence, spatial->spatial_intelligence, musical->musical_intelligence, bodily->bodily_intelligence, naturalistic->naturalistic_intelligence, existential->existential_intelligence, logical->logical_intelligence, attention_span->focus, dogmatism->firmness) and nine added (processing_speed, uncertainty_tolerance, intrapersonal_intelligence, practical_intelligence, divergent_thinking, convergent_thinking, collaboration, interpersonal_intelligence, propensity_to_go_deep). NEUROTICISM WAS REPLACED BY ITS INVERSE, EMOTIONAL STABILITY, on 2026-08-16 - every factor now means the same thing, more is more, and nothing in the model inverts it.
usage: role_spread.deviating_roles[].higher / .lower may name ONLY these slugs, and always RELATIVE to the profession's own baseline — never as absolute scores. The validator rejects unknown slugs. The matching vector is the 27 excluding `confidence`; the authoritative lists live in Backend/scoring/scoreProfile.js (MAJOR_FACTORS / MINOR_FACTORS / UNIVERSAL_FACTORS / MATCHING_FACTORS) and this file is generated from them.

groups.note: Combinations of the personality and cognitive factors above. Self-report: these measure affinity, not measured ability.
UNIVERSAL — scored for the readiness layer and available to role_spread, but excluded from the matching vector. A factor every profession needs cannot tell you which profession to choose.

factors.name: Focus / attention span / ability to concentrate

groups.note: Derived from the factors above. They discriminate between professions, so they stay in the matching vector — but they are re-mixes of majors already in it, which is why the matching engine gives the group a lower weight than the majors.
